combinationId.description: The opaque id identifying this unique combination of space permissions. Pass directly to the bulk role-assignments or access-removals endpoints.

spaceCount.description: Number of spaces that currently have this combination.

principalCount.description: Number of principals (users / groups / etc.) that currently have this combination.

permissions.description: The decoded space permissions that make up this combination.

principalTypes.description:
The principal types that currently hold this combination and can be reassigned via the
bulk role-assignments endpoint. Use this to know which `principalType` entries are valid
to include in the bulk-assign request for this combination.
